response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and backend development, but his resume shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this Principal-level role. His career trajectory also lacks evidence of the large-scale, multi-team technical leadership and strategic influence expected at an IC6/Principal level.
strengths: Extensive, diverse technical background spanning multiple languages (JS/TS, C#, Java, DLang) and system types (web, mobile, embedded)
Demonstrated experience with high-throughput, low-latency microservices (Dunnhumby media) relevant to distributed systems requirements
Track record of mentoring, teaching, and community involvement (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
concerns: No visible experience with experimentation systems, A/B testing frameworks, feature flighting, or growth metrics platforms
No mention of Python proficiency, and telemetry/data-analysis experience is not evidenced
Career history shows Senior/Staff-level roles without clear indication of Principal-level, cross-org technical leadership or ambiguous-to-measurable outcome ownership

key_factors.factor: No demonstrated telemetry/metrics or data-driven experimentation analysis work
Strong general engineering breadth and seniority (15+ years, multiple languages/systems)
